changes: Recovery keys in Settings: view the current wallet’s 200 address keys for each of all 18 supported coins, including disabled legacy assets, in a ten-key-per-page list.
Copy controls: copy a receiving address, compressed public key, individual private key (WIF), or all 200 private keys for the selected coin.

Privacy protections: an explicit acknowledgment plus the existing wallet-password and enabled device-authentication checks are required before showing keys. Keys hide after two minutes, navigation, locking or backgrounding.
Local-only derivation: private-key lists are never persisted or sent to a server. Viewing keys does not enable assets or change wallet selection, fee rules, addresses or transaction signing.

Android clipboard protection: recovery copies are marked sensitive and the app attempts to clear its own copy after one minute without clearing a newer unrelated copy. Other apps or clipboard history may retain copied keys.

Recovery compatibility: existing seed paths and JSON backups remain unchanged. These lists cover SafeCore-derived keys, not separate legacy Komodo sweep keys; keep the recovery phrase and JSON backup for full recovery.

Verification: adds disposable-wallet tests for all 200 keys on all 18 coins, independent derivation, offline-tool parity, passphrases, password/authentication gates, wallet isolation, clipboard handling, expiry and compact layouts.

Android update: versionCode 22, debugging disabled, using the existing development signing identity. Test.21 remains available; update in place without uninstalling or clearing wallet data. This is an unaudited development prerelease.
